title: Supabase theme
description: A quiet developer-platform light theme: a #fdfdfd page with white cards, near-black ink and mid-grey copy, ink-at-8% hairlines, and one brand green (deep #0f7e4f for buttons, bright mint for marks and lit dots). Manrope headings in medium weight over Inter 450 body and Source Code Pro for code; 16px cards, 6px buttons. A #121212 dark sibling.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a sibling in the same spirit and also colours the dark brand strips on the light page
--highlight is the bright mint (marks, lit dots); --primary the deep green for buttons
chart-1..3 are code syntax colours (keyword, name, string); chart-4 → chart-5 is the pink→orange story gradient, the same in both modes
--section-y is the phone padding (4rem); blocks use 1.5× on desktop
